pt-br:settings.claudeCode.title.en: Also use my Claude Code setup

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.note.text: Copie suas Habilidades e ferramentas do Claude Code para o Murage uma única vez. O Murage só lê esses itens quando você clica em "Revisar o que será copiado" e só volta a ler quando você clica nesse botão novamente.
pt-br:settings.claudeCode.note.en: Copy your Claude Code skills and tools into Murage, once. Murage reads them only when you press Review, and does not look again until you press it.

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.switch.text: Mostrar "Revisar o que será copiado" e "Importar"

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.skillsOff.text: As Habilidades são adicionadas desativadas. Revise cada uma antes de ativar.
pt-br:settings.claudeCode.skillsOff.en: Skills are added turned off. Turn each one on after you look at it.

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.toolsOff.text: As ferramentas são adicionadas desativadas. Ative cada uma e teste antes de usar. As chaves nunca são copiadas.
pt-br:settings.claudeCode.toolsOff.en: Tools are added turned off. Turn each one on and test it first. Keys are never copied.

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.skipped.text: {count} itens ignorados porque já estão aqui ou não podem ser usados.
pt-br:settings.claudeCode.skipped.en: {count} skipped because they are already here or cannot be used.

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.done.text: Foram adicionadas {skills} Habilidades e {servers} ferramentas. {needsKey} precisam da sua chave.
pt-br:settings.claudeCode.done.en: Added {skills} skills and {servers} tools. {needsKey} need your key.

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.last.text: Última cópia: {skills} Habilidades e {servers} ferramentas no total. {needsKey} precisam da sua chave.
pt-br:settings.claudeCode.last.en: Last copy: {skills} skills and {servers} tools in all. {needsKey} need your key.

pt-br:settings.claudeCode.error.text: Não foi possível ler os arquivos do Claude Code. Nada foi alterado.
pt-br:settings.claudeCode.error.en: Could not read Claude Code files. Nothing was changed.

zh:settings.channels.allowEmpty.text: 要选择哪些人可以向你的机器人发消息，请连接 WhatsApp，然后选择“我和指定联系人”。
zh:settings.channels.allowEmpty.en: To choose who can message your bots, link WhatsApp and pick Me and chosen contacts.

zh:settings.channels.groupsEmpty.text: 要选择机器人在哪些群组中回复，请先连接 WhatsApp。
zh:settings.channels.groupsEmpty.en: To choose the groups your bots answer in, link WhatsApp first.

zh:settings.usage.noRoutine.text: 本月暂无例行任务活动。

zh:settings.computer.defaultNote.text: 新机器人会在你在此选择的电脑上启动。现有机器人会继续使用各自的电脑。如果所选电脑不在这里，新机器人会在这台电脑上启动。
zh:settings.computer.defaultNote.en: The computer a new bot starts on. Bots you already have keep theirs. If the computer you pick is not here, a new bot starts on this computer.

zh:settings.computer.defaultPerBot.text: 在 {bot} > 访问权限 > 电脑中为每个机器人单独设置
zh:settings.computer.defaultPerBot.en: Set it per bot under {bot} > Access > Computer

zh:settings.computer.defaultError.text: 无法保存默认电脑设置，请重试。
zh:settings.computer.defaultError.en: Could not save the default computer. Try again.

zh:settings.claudeCode.title.text: 同时使用我的 Claude Code 配置
zh:settings.claudeCode.title.en: Also use my Claude Code setup

zh:settings.claudeCode.note.text: 将你的 Claude Code 技能和工具一次性复制到 Murage。Murage 仅在你点击“查看将复制的内容”时读取它们，直到你再次点击该按钮才会重新读取。
zh:settings.claudeCode.note.en: Copy your Claude Code skills and tools into Murage, once. Murage reads them only when you press Review, and does not look again until you press it.

zh:settings.claudeCode.switch.text: 显示“查看将复制的内容”和“导入”按钮

zh:settings.claudeCode.skillsOff.text: 技能添加后默认关闭。请查看后逐一开启。
zh:settings.claudeCode.skillsOff.en: Skills are added turned off. Turn each one on after you look at it.

zh:settings.claudeCode.toolsOff.text: 工具添加后默认关闭。请逐一开启并先进行测试。密钥不会被复制。
zh:settings.claudeCode.toolsOff.en: Tools are added turned off. Turn each one on and test it first. Keys are never copied.

zh:settings.claudeCode.skipped.text: 已跳过 {count} 项，因为它们已存在或无法使用。
zh:settings.claudeCode.skipped.en: {count} skipped because they are already here or cannot be used.

zh:settings.claudeCode.done.text: 已添加 {skills} 个技能和 {servers} 个工具。其中 {needsKey} 项需要你的密钥。
zh:settings.claudeCode.done.en: Added {skills} skills and {servers} tools. {needsKey} need your key.

zh:settings.claudeCode.last.text: 上次复制：共 {skills} 个技能和 {servers} 个工具。其中 {needsKey} 项需要你的密钥。
zh:settings.claudeCode.last.en: Last copy: {skills} skills and {servers} tools in all. {needsKey} need your key.

zh:settings.claudeCode.error.text: 无法读取 Claude Code 文件。未做任何更改。
zh:settings.claudeCode.error.en: Could not read Claude Code files. Nothing was changed.
